name: validate.sh
rederives: re-runs every gate from source on the actual working tree

name: pre-commit gate
rederives: blocks the git commit unless validate.sh exits 0

name: enforce-locations
rederives: blocks Write/Edit tool calls that target disallowed file locations

name: stop_verification
rederives: blocks session Stop unless every feature is verified against the live app

name: check_mutation
rederives: mutates source and re-runs the suite to re-derive that tests actually fail on real breakage

name: shell-guard
rederives: blocks the Bash tool call before a dangerous command can run
